_comment: Sample build config for a MANAGED tenant (a customer's PIM Manager that pulls the managing tenant's signed baseline). Copy it to managed-tenant.json, replace every value, then run tools/setup/Invoke-PimMspBuild.ps1 -Role Slave -ConfigPath <file> -EnrollmentKey <the key your managing company gave you> (plan), and again with -Apply. With the enrollment key the managing tenant's bundle address and signing key ids come from Invardia; without one, add the 'master' block the managing tenant's build printed. Ids and names only -- never a secret, never the enrollment key. See config-msp/README.md.
